questions.questionText: Which neuroimaging technique would reveal problems in the anatomical structure of the brain but not problems in function?
options: CT
PET
SPECT
None of the above.
questions.correctAnswer: CT
questions.explanationText: CT (computed tomography) provides detailed images of the brain's anatomical structures, allowing healthcare providers to identify structural abnormalities such as bleeding, tumors, or swelling. PET and SPECT scans primarily assess brain function by showing metabolic activity or blood flow.
